title: Elizondo won't confirm or deny Immaculate Constellation before Congress

tellings.quote: and if you even watch him in front of Congress, you know, uh, in September of 24, he's saying, "I can't confirm or deny being read into, you know, Immaculate Constellation."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official, told a hearing of the US Congress in September 2024 that he could neither confirm nor deny being briefed on Immaculate Constellation, a reported secret military program said to gather UFO data. Michels reads that careful answer as meaningful, since, if the program exists, it would point to a hidden UFO effort that Congress has not been told about.
